propositions: Inbound STATUS writes bypass the parent-first cascade, allowing invalid states where a closed parent holds an active child.
The operator ruled that rebar must maintain an invariant: no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket.

Inbound status changes into active statuses must cascade eligible ancestors in topmost-first order, mirroring the interactive cascade via shared decision tables (_CASCADING_EDGES and _resolve_parent_in_status).
Same-status inbound STATUS writes must be suppressed as no-ops to ensure batch self-consistency and idempotency when parent and child mutations occur in the same batch.
The cascade helper must be implemented in apply_inbound_events.py without routing through transition_compute to avoid imposing interactive gates (plan-review LLM) on reconcile batches.
